title: BBC Learning English from the News 2025 — Quiz 10
description: Choose the best answer for each question about vocabulary and usage.

elements.name: q091_chilling
elements.title: The recording contained a ___ scream that frightened everyone who heard it.

elements.name: q092_party_line
elements.title: The spokesperson repeated the ___, giving the organisation's official position word for word.

elements.name: q093_wild
elements.title: He offered a ___ explanation: he claimed the missing parcel had been carried off by a flock of ducks.

elements.name: q094_deadly
elements.title: The disease can be ___ if left untreated, so doctors urged patients to seek help.

elements.name: q095_fuel
elements.title: Repeating the accusation without evidence could ___ the dispute and make it worse.

elements.name: q096_sound_the_alarm
elements.title: The researcher decided to ___ about the worsening shortage and warn the public.

elements.name: q097_face_off
elements.title: The two teams will ___ in the final to decide who wins the cup.

elements.name: q098_take_a_beating
elements.title: The old fence ___ during the storm, losing several panels.

elements.name: q099_unscathed
elements.title: Although the box was dented, its contents came through the journey ___.

elements.name: q100_jabs
elements.title: In the sentence “The nurse gave him two jabs”, what were the jabs?
